research_questions.RQ1: Nominal learning performance and learning efficiency under the common actual-environment-interaction budget.
research_questions.RQ2: Resilience and matched adaptation benefit after controlled uncertainty/change, retaining (FN-FD)-(AN-AD).
research_questions.RQ3: Recovery speed and non-recovery after persistent unannounced change using matched Adaptive-Nominal and Adaptive-Disturbed trajectories.

recovery_speed.episode_boundary_handling: fixed interaction windows continue across episode boundaries; boundaries do not reset or realign windows
recovery_speed.recovery_rule: for higher-is-better performance, AD is in tolerance when AN-AD <= tolerance; stable recovery is the first run of two consecutive in-tolerance windows
recovery_speed.recovery_time_definition: end interaction of the first window in the first stable run
recovery_speed.confirmation_time_definition: end interaction of the final window required by the stability rule
recovery_speed.layout_reduction: equal weighting within independent root before recovery inference

method_contrasts.layout_policy: layouts are repeated/blocked observations reduced equally within root
primary: RQ3 recovery time/status on action-remap conditions
method_contrasts.inference: effect-estimation with pointwise root-level intervals; no formal p-value superiority testing

gate.required_before_T_610: T-533 implementation, validation, documentation reconciliation, affected CI and objective review
